prerequisites: Knowledge of fundamental magnitudes: dimensional, force, flow rate, pressure, power, electrical, etc.
Basic PC handling (word processor, spreadsheets, file manipulation, etc.).

learning_outcomes.text: Understand and possess knowledge.
Application of knowledge.
Ability to make judgments.
Basic knowledge of the profession.
Teamwork.
Ability to learn to work autonomously.
Basic knowledge of production and manufacturing systems.
Basic knowledge and application of environmental technologies and sustainability.
Applied knowledge of business organization.
Basic knowledge of different manufacturing processes.
Basic knowledge of the operation of industrial equipment-machines.
Basic knowledge of production organization.
Basic knowledge of concepts related to environment, sustainability, pollution and treatment. Basic causes of water and air pollution. Sources of industrial pollution.
For the student to acquire a general knowledge of manufacturing processes and the machines involved in them.
For the student to know the relationships and material flow between different manufacturing processes.
The student must know the operation of basic machinery for sheet metal forming and machine tools.
The student must be able to write reports correctly, using appropriate software, combining the use of word processors and specific data and/or graphics processing programs.
The student must know how to access information sources available on the network and databases.
The student must know how to communicate and send information over the network.
The student must know how to work in a group, respecting others, planning and completing tasks in a timely and correct manner.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1. Introduction to Manufacturing. Processes and Systems.
Topic 2. Manufacturing systems and processes. Production organization.
Topic 5. Forming processes by plastic deformation.
Practice 3. Introduction to CNC Machine Tool Programming.
Practice 4. Introduction to Handling and Programming an Anthropomorphic Robot.
Practice 5. Introduction to Handling and Programming 3D Printers.
assessment_rules: For the Main Exam (Theory and practicals), it is necessary to obtain at least 5 out of 10 points to pass. To access the 20% from "Theory and practical activities," students must have an average grade equal to or greater than 5.0 and complete specific activities (at least 1 questionnaire; activities P2, P3, and P6; and either T2 or T6 activity). For students who have not completed or passed these activities, an Additional Exam accounting for 20% of the global grade is required, also needing at least 5 out of 10 points to pass. Detection of plagiarism and/or AI use in any activity will result in a zero for all activities.
